name: Ferienwohnung Osl
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily located in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Osl welcomes visitors with a cosy atmosphere, bright rooms, and views of the Zahmer Kaiser.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, trailheads into the Kaiser valley, and cycling routes are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Osl in Ebbs provides restful holiday comfort at the foot of the Kaiser mountains.
